name: Arrhephoria
summary: The secret night rite of the Arrhephoroi — two girls chosen for Athena who carry covered baskets down from the Acropolis and bring other sacred things back — ending their year of service as the old year closes.
testimonia: Pausanias 1.27.3 (the Arrhephoroi and the underground descent)
Aristophanes, Lysistrata 641–647 (arrhephoros among a girl's ritual stages)
